analyst_view.overall: Early view: a Friday-night meeting of two sides in trouble: Alanyaspor (13th) had lost four straight under Joao Pereira by the break, and Konyaspor (15th, 8 pts) have one of the league's weakest attacks and no away win this season. Both play the weekend before (Alanyaspor at Kasimpasa, Konyaspor at home to Besiktas), so the mood here will depend on those results.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals and I lean lower. These two have scored 15 goals between them in 22 league games, Konyaspor have lost four of their five away games, and Alanyaspor have one goal in their last three, so a nervy, low-scoring game looks more likely than an open one.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.0 corners. Alanyaspor should push at home and Konyaspor can be dangerous from crosses (they hit the bar with headers at Samsunspor), so there is no strong reason to move.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.8 cards and I lean slightly higher. With both sides near the relegation places the tackles will be fierce; Konyaspor picked up two yellows and had a red overturned at Samsunspor, and Alanyaspor's run has left them frustrated.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.5 shots. Neither side creates much at the moment, and Pereira said his team effectively did not turn up for the first half of their loss at Kocaelispor, so I lean lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.8 shots on target. With two blunt attacks I lean slightly lower; Konyaspor have scored six all season, which points to few efforts that really test a keeper.
